title: Coach v9 Review Report
description: Review report emitted by a reviewer agent at a phase boundary and ingested by coach. Producer: reviewer agent (#526). Consumer: coach intake validator (#N2), runtime `atdd agent review` (#N5), judge call site #2 (#N4). Spec: atdd-coach-spec-v9.md §6.3 (verdict routing), §7.4 (schema + hard rules), §7.7 (schema inventory). Single-doc JSON written to `.atdd/runtime/agents/<id>/reviews/<review_id>.json` only after passing intake validation.

review_id.description: Unique identifier for this review (typically a UUID).

target_commit.description: Commit SHA the review was performed against (minimum 7 chars).

reviewer_agent_id.description: Registered agent id of the reviewer that produced this report.

wmbt_urn.description: URN of the WMBT this review covers (e.g. `wmbt:review-phase-boundaries:D002`).

phase.description: ATDD lifecycle phase boundary at which this review was requested.

verdict.description: Overall verdict. `pass` → next state; `fail` → respawn with feedback; `concern` → judge call site #2. Hard rules at intake prevent `pass` when ACs are uncovered or strict findings remain.

tier1_risk_score.description: Risk score from `validations/<sha>/risk-score.json` at review time.

findings.description: Ordered list of findings. Each finding may cite a registered rule_id or be an LLM-only observation (rule_id = null).

ac_coverage.description: Map of acceptance URN to coverage status. Every acceptance_ref in the WMBT must appear as a key. Coverage status: `covered` | `not_covered` | `partial`.

summary.description: Free-form human-readable summary of the review.

recommendations.description: Optional ordered list of remediation recommendations.

rule_id.description: Canonical rule id from the substrate registry (resolved via `bind_rule()`). Null for LLM-only findings with no registered rule.

rule_id_legacy_alias.description: Optional legacy flat-grammar alias for the rule_id. Present for backward-compatibility with older suppression markers.

severity.description: Severity 1 (informational) through 5 (blocking). When rule_id is non-null, this MUST match `bind_rule(rule_id).severity`.

disposition.description: Required when rule_id is non-null. MUST match `bind_rule(rule_id).disposition`. Null/absent for LLM-only findings.

surface.description: The review surface this finding was observed on.

location.description: File path, URN, or other locator for the finding.

acceptance_ref.description: Acceptance URN this finding relates to (e.g. `acc:review-phase-boundaries:D002-UNIT-001-review-report-schema-committed`).

evidence.description: Verbatim evidence supporting the finding (e.g. a log excerpt, code snippet, or validator output).
